rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=800, val_n=200, epochs=40, batch_size=1, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=32, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-20 (FINAL, 20/20). EXACT iter-13 champion replicate: tn800,c32,bs1,ep40,lr2e-4,win8,heads8,gc1.0,seed=42 (iter-13 scored hr=0.8696,ssim=0.9988). Rationale: seed=2024 (iter-19) and seed=2025 both hit a transient CUDA IndexKernel/CUDNN_NOT_INITIALIZED crash in the Swin window-attention on the first forward (5-11s, hr=0); solver src is byte-identical to iter-13, so this is a flaky-node/env fault, not a config fault. Reproducing the KNOWN-GOOD seed=42 removes the seed as a variable and produces the champion ckpt+recon for the final 20/20 deliverable. Confirms tn800-optimum reproduces at hr~0.87.
